images.filename: Bundesarchiv Bild 101I-121-0011A-22, Polen, Siegesparade, Guderian, Kriwoschein.jpg
images.caption: Poland, Brześć Litewski [Brest-Litovsk] (today Brest in Belarus). German-Soviet victory parade; personnel, from left to right:  Major General Mauritz von Wiktorin,  General of Panzer Troops [(Lt. Gen.)] Heinz Guderian and Brigadier General Semyon Krivoshein. Same image, but of lower quality, was found in Warsaw Mechanical Documentation Archive, labeled as first published in Soviet Union by TASS in 1939 (as a part of newsreel). See also cropped image at File:Armia Czerwona,Wehrmacht 22.09.1939 wspólna parada.jpg.
